limitations: Historical candle-label calibration and return uncertainty are proxies, not validated forward quote probabilities or executable profit

No-trade decision does not remove hard samples from full forecast scores
NO_TRADE daily market forecasts continue; missing challenger pairs remain missing in coverage denominator
Pairs without pre-target GitHub server witness are excluded from valid accuracy but remain in due denominator
Costs and normal return lower proxy are fixed exploratory assumptions, not a trading authorization
